  • Bone mineralization
  • Energy metabolism

It is part of the Kevin Levrone Black Line, which targets intermediate and advanced athletes seeking to optimize their physique.
Product Overview
  • Purpose: Formulated to help reduce excess water retention and improve muscle hardness and definition during cutting phases. 
  • Key Ingredients: Features a blend of natural botanical extracts including:
    • Stinging Nettle root extract: Traditionally used for fluid balance.
    • Uva Ursi root extract: Known for its diuretic properties.
    • Guarana seeds: Contains caffeine to support energy and metabolic rate.
    • Dandelion root extract: A common herbal diuretic.
    • Additional Botanicals: Includes Juniper Berry, Green Tea Leaf, White Willow Bark, and BioPerine® for enhanced absorption.
description:
The Kevin Levrone Anabolic Diuretic is a high-performance metabolic supplement from the “Black Line” series, specifically engineered for bodybuilders and athletes who need to eliminate subcutaneous water to achieve a “dry,” vascular, and rock-hard physique. Developed in collaboration with IFBB legend Kevin Levrone, this formula bridges the gap between traditional herbal remedies and professional-grade sports nutrition.
Core Benefits and Functionality
The primary goal of this supplement is fluid management. By flushing out excess water trapped between the skin and the muscle, it helps reveal the deep striations and muscle density that are often hidden by bloating.
  • Muscle Hardness: Ideal for the final weeks of a contest prep or a photoshoot to ensure every muscle fiber is visible.
  • Weight Management: Often used as a tool to make weight in sports with specific weight classes without sacrificing muscle mass.
  • Electrolyte Support: Unlike harsh chemical diuretics, this formula includes botanical extracts that aim to manage fluid levels more naturally.

Key Ingredient Breakdown
The effectiveness of Anabolic Diuretic lies in its diverse, multi-phase botanical blend:
  1. Natural Diuretic Complex: Features Dandelion Root, Uva Ursi, and Stinging Nettle. These are powerhouse herbs known for increasing urine output and supporting kidney filtration to move stagnant water.
  2. Thermogenic Support: Includes Guarana Seed and Green Tea Leaf Extract. These provide a natural caffeine kick that boosts the metabolic rate, aiding in fat oxidation while simultaneously acting as mild diuretics.
  3. Inflammation & Recovery: White Willow Bark (a natural source of salicin) is included to help manage the minor systemic inflammation often associated with intense training and “drying out.”
  4. Bioavailability: The formula is rounded out with BioPerine® (Black Pepper Extract), which significantly increases the absorption of the other herbal components, ensuring nothing goes to waste.

Suggested Use & Strategy
To get the most out of the 90-tablet bottle:
  • Dosage: The standard serving is typically 3 tablets daily, preferably taken with a meal.
  • The “Water Paradox”: It sounds counterintuitive, but you must drink more water (at least 3–4 liters a day) while taking this. If you stop drinking water, your body will fight to hold onto every drop it has, negating the supplement’s effects.
  • Cycle Length: This is not a year-round supplement. It is best used in short bursts (typically 10–14 days) leading up to a specific event.

Safety & Quality Standards
As part of the Kevin Levrone Signature Series, this product is manufactured under strict quality controls. However, because it impacts hydration levels:
  • Avoid taking it late in the evening due to the caffeine content.
  • Discontinue use if you experience severe muscle cramps or dizziness.
  • Always consult a professional if you have pre-existing kidney or heart conditions.

ISOPURE Creatine 250g is a premium-quality dietary supplement designed to support strength, power, and overall athletic performance. Formulated with pure creatine monohydrate, one of the most researched and trusted ingredients in sports nutrition, this supplement helps fuel your muscles during high-intensity workouts and promotes faster recovery between training sessions.

Creatine plays a key role in the production of ATP (adenosine triphosphate), the primary energy source for muscle contractions. By increasing your body’s creatine stores, ISOPURE Creatine helps enhance energy availability, allowing you to push harder, lift heavier, and perform more reps during resistance training. This makes it an excellent choice for athletes, bodybuilders, fitness enthusiasts, and anyone looking to improve their physical performance.

Each serving of ISOPURE Creatine is unflavored and easily mixable, ensuring it can be seamlessly added to your favorite beverages such as water, juice, or protein shakes without altering taste. The fine powder dissolves quickly, leaving no gritty residue, making it convenient for daily use.

One of the standout features of ISOPURE Creatine is its purity. It contains no added sugars, artificial flavors, colors, or unnecessary fillers, making it suitable for those following clean nutrition plans. Whether you are in a bulking phase, cutting phase, or simply maintaining your fitness routine, this supplement supports lean muscle development without adding unwanted calories.

Regular use of ISOPURE Creatine may help improve muscle strength, increase endurance, support muscle hydration, and enhance post-workout recovery. It can also contribute to improved muscle volume by drawing water into muscle cells, giving a fuller and more defined appearance.

Packaged in a convenient 250g container, ISOPURE Creatine offers a sufficient supply for consistent supplementation, making it a reliable addition to your fitness regimen. It is suitable for both beginners and experienced athletes looking for a simple, effective, and science-backed performance booster.

For best results, it is recommended to consume as directed, typically mixed with water or a beverage of choice, and combined with a balanced diet and regular exercise program.

ISOPURE Creatine 250g is your go-to supplement for unlocking greater strength, endurance, and performance—helping you take your workouts to the next level.

description:
Bpi Cla+ Carnitine 50ser

NON STIMULANT WEIGHT LOSS

BPI Sports CLA + Carnitine is a tested and trusted non-stimulant weight loss supplement that not only helps boost performance, but also improves metabolism.

Conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) and carnitine are two popular ingredients that have been clinically shown to help with weight management.

CLA works by inhibiting lipoprotein lipase (LPL). LPL allows fat cells to extract fat from the bloodstream and store it.

By curbing LPL, CLA effectively prevents fat storage, encouraging the body to burn it instead.* Carnitine supports weight loss due to its role as a fat transporter.

Even when you’re burning a ton of calories each day, you won’t necessarily burn off fat.

That’s because fat must first reach the mitochondria, the powerhouse of your body’s cells.

The easiest way to ensure this happens is by supplementing with a fat transporter, like carnitine.

Carnitine helps maximize the amount of freed-up fat cells you can burn away for good by transporting the fat cells directly into the mitochondria.

name: Buy Best Bpi Beta Alanine 180g 90 Serving
description:
Bpi Beta Alanine 180g – Beta-Alanine is a precursor to carnosine synthesis in the body. Carnosine is the enzyme which helps in an enhanced workout performance as it delays the onset of muscle fatigue which helps you to work out for a longer duration. Longer workouts mean better results and better success in achieving your fitness goals. MuscleBlaze® Beta-Alanine is composed of 100% CarnoSyn® only. CarnoSyn® is the only food grade beta-alanine approved by NAI, USA.

What is Beta Alanine?

Beta-alanine is a type of non-essential amino acid that is produced naturally in the body. Some of the excellent sources of beta-alanine are meat, fish, and poultry. Undoubtedly, Beta-alanine is in demand among athletes and fitness enthusiasts. Most of the amino acids are used by your body to synthesize proteins, but it is not the case with beta-alanine, instead, together with histidine (a basic amino acid that is a constituent of most proteins), it produces carnosine. description:
Bpi Cla+ Carnitine 50ser

NON STIMULANT WEIGHT LOSS

BPI Sports CLA + Carnitine is a tested and trusted non-stimulant weight loss supplement that not only helps boost performance, but also improves metabolism.

Conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) and carnitine are two popular ingredients that have been clinically shown to help with weight management.

CLA works by inhibiting lipoprotein lipase (LPL). LPL allows fat cells to extract fat from the bloodstream and store it.

By curbing LPL, CLA effectively prevents fat storage, encouraging the body to burn it instead.* Carnitine supports weight loss due to its role as a fat transporter.

Even when you’re burning a ton of calories each day, you won’t necessarily burn off fat.

That’s because fat must first reach the mitochondria, the powerhouse of your body’s cells.

The easiest way to ensure this happens is by supplementing with a fat transporter, like carnitine.

Carnitine helps maximize the amount of freed-up fat cells you can burn away for good by transporting the fat cells directly into the mitochondria.

Flavor:Fruit Punch

What are BCAAs? BCAAs are the essential amino acids leucine, isoleucine, and valine, which comprise around 35-40% of your body’s muscle protein. They’re essential because your body doesn’t make them on its own and hence you must get them from food or workout supplements. Out of the nine essential amino acids, the BCAAs (Leucine, Iso-leucine & Valine) play a crucial role in muscle protein synthesis and recovery. They also help preserve muscle glycogen stores, which fuel your muscles and minimize protein breakdown during exercise. In simple terms, BCAAs can help you get more out of your daily gym sessions.

Why is an additional BCAA supplement required? Doesn’t protein provide enough BCAAs? BCAAs as a supplement gets absorbed in minutes and as an intra-workout, it gets transported to muscle cells quicker, thereby decreasing muscle breakdown during training. Proteins have BCAAs but they take more time to digest, as a result, they are not available to your body when you are working out. Supplementing with BCAAs helps preserve your stores of glycogen—the primary fuel your muscles use for energy production.

This means your body has a reliable energy source to tap into while you work out, which can keep you going. That’s potentially more energy, more reps and more gains. How is BCAA Gold different from other BCAA supplements? BCAA Gold has a ratio of 8:1:1 for L-Leucine, L-Isoleucine, and L-valine respectively unlike other supplements having a ratio of 2:1:1 for the same amino acids. Leucine has the most crucial role to play amongst the BCAAs and higher leucine content helps speed up muscle protein synthesis and hence muscle growth. Apart from this, BCAA Gold fuels your muscles with glutamine, citrulline, and electrolytes which together boost your workout performance and elevates the results.

Informed-Choice is a quality assurance program for sports nutrition products. ON 100% Whey Gold Standard The program certifies that nutritional supplements that bears the Informed-Choice logo have been tested for banned substances by the world class sports anti-doping lab, LGC Limited.

Suggested Use

For healthy adults, consume enough protein to meet your daily protein requirements through a combination of high protein foods and protein supplements throughout the day as part of a balanced diet and exercise program.

Spoon Stirred: Gold Standard 100% Whey™ is instantized. That means if you forgot your shaker cup or don’t have time to get out the blender, just add one scoop of Gold Standard 100% Whey™ to a glass filled with 6-8 oz of water or your favorite beverage. Then mix it up with a spoon. Stir for about 30 seconds or until powder is completely dissolved. Tip: Adjust the taste of your Gold Standard 100% Whey™ by varying the amount of liquid that you use to prepare it. ON 100% Whey Gold Standard For a bolder flavor with slightly more body and sweetness, mix each scoop with 4-6 oz of water, milk, or your favorite beverage. For a milder tasting, less sweet shake, use 8-10 oz of liquid per scoop.

Shaker Cup: Bringing a shaker cup with you to the gym is the best way to get a dose of protein immediately after your workout. Just pour in 6-8 oz of your preferred beverage and then add one rounded scoop of Gold Standard 100% Whey™ to your shaker cup. Cover and shake for 25-30 seconds.

Blender: Add one scoop of Gold Standard 100% Whey™ to a blender filled with 6-8 oz of water or your favorite beverage. Blend for 20-30 seconds. Then add 1 or 2 ice cubes and blend for an additional 30 seconds. Shake Up Your Shake: By adding fresh, or frozen fruits, peanut butter, flax seed oil, coconut and other ingredients, you can make an even more delicious shake. Stack Your Shake: You can make Gold Standard 100% Whey™ an even better post workout product by adding supplements like Creatine, Glutamine, BCAA, and concentrated carbohydrate powders.

Think Outside The Glass: Gold Standard 100% Whey™ can be used for more than just protein shakes. ON 100% Whey Gold Standard Try mixing a scoop into oatmeal, yogurt, or the milk that you pour over your morning breakfast cereal. Better yet, increase the protein content of muffins, cookies, brownies, etc. by adding a scoop or two to your baked goods recipes.

Protein blend (whey protein isolate, whey protein concentrate, whey peptides), natural and artificial flavors, soy lecithin, acesulfame potassium, sucralose, FD&C red #40, lactase.

Allergen information: Contains milk and soy (lecithin) ingredients.

Warnings

Notice: Use this product as a food supplement only. Do not use for weight reduction.

Store in a cool, dry place.

Contents sold by weight no volume.

Serving scoop included, but may settle to the bottom during shipping.

short_description:
Product description

What are BCAAs? BCAAs are the essential amino acids leucine, isoleucine and valine, which comprise around 35-40% of your body’s muscle protein. They’re essential because your body doesn’t make them on its own and hence you must get them from food or workout supplements. Out of the nine essential amino acids, the BCAAs (Leucine, Iso-leucine & Valine) play a crucial role in muscle protein synthesis and recovery. They also help preserve muscle glycogen stores, which fuel your muscles and minimize protein breakdown during exercise. In simple terms, BCAAs can help you get more out of your daily gym sessions. Why is an additional BCAA supplement required? Doesn’t protein provide enough BCAAs? BCAAs as a supplement gets absorbed in minutes and as an intra-workout, it gets transported to muscle cells quicker, thereby decreasing muscle breakdown during training. Proteins have BCAAs but they take more time to digest, as a result they are not available to your body when you are working out. Supplementing with BCAAs helps preserve your stores of glycogen—the primary fuel your muscles use for energy production. This means your body has a reliable energy source to tap into while you work out, which can keep you going. That’s potentially more energy, more reps and more gains. How is BCAA Gold different from other BCAA supplements? BCAA Gold has a ratio of 8:1:1 for L-Leucine, L-Isoleucine, and L-valine respectively unlike other supplements having a ratio of 2:1:1 for the same amino acids. Leucine has the most crucial role to play amongst the BCAAs and higher leucine content helps speed up muscle protein synthesis and hence muscle growth. Apart from this, BCAA Gold fuels your muscles with glutamine, citrulline, and electrolytes which together boost your workout performance and elevates the results.
